assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes.
The monitoring is consistent with the payer's determination under CO-22.
The appeal requests that the denial be reversed based on the documented clinical indication of recurrent dizziness and giddiness linked to the patient's known coronary and valvular disease.
